title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (go) — review required
description: In go, naming MD5 (h := md5.New()) requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The go-specific remedy is selecting sha256.New().
applicability: go codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
